author: Inside Edition
description: President Trump doubled down on comments he made about striking Iran if the Strait of Hormuz is not reopened. "A whole civilization will die tonight, never to be brought back again," Trump wrote on Truth Social. He says he has proposed a deal to end the war and is giving Iran until 8 p.m. Eastern time Tuesday night to accept. His post follows threats he made Monday, telling reporters how an American attack would devastate the country. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Trump Warns 'A Whole Civilization Will Die' If Iran Doesn't Accept Deal
